title: PCA-Theta: Code and data for correlation-aware sequential sampling for multi-output polynomial chaos expansions
description:
Code and reference data accompanying Correlation-aware sequential sampling for multi-output polynomial chaos expansions.

The package implements six experimental-design strategies: Random, Latin hypercube sampling, multi-output Theta, PCA-Theta, and adaptively weighted versions of Theta and PCA-Theta. It includes Gaussian, wave, two-dimensional random-field and five-dimensional Karhunen-Loève examples, OLS fitting, SVD-based analytical leave-one-out degree selection in the two-dimensional examples, and Jupyter notebooks for reproducing the manuscript figures.

Reference results contain 50 repetitions for each two-dimensional comparison. The five-dimensional example uses one field realization and four adaptive methods, fixed degree p=10, 3010 to 8000 training points, and batches of 10. Numerical inputs, plotting arrays, timing tables, environment requirements and inline figure previews are included. Large disposable basis caches are regenerated from the supplied inputs.

LHS is generated independently at each training budget after a shared initial random design. The plotted budget for LHS is the size of an individual design, not the cumulative number of evaluations over all plotted budgets. Timing interpretation and PCA measures are documented in README.md.
